# GWA Calculator Philippines

> A free online General Weighted Average (GWA) calculator for Philippine college and university students. Add your subjects with their units and grades and it computes your GWA instantly. No account needed; your subjects are saved in your own browser.

- Website: https://gwaphcalc.shaunniekins.com/
- Price: free, no sign-up, no ads
- Platforms: any modern web browser, desktop or mobile
- Source code: https://github.com/shaunniekins/gwa-ph-calc

## Good fit for people looking for

- A GWA calculator for Philippine universities (1.0 to 5.0 grading scale, as used by UP and many other schools)
- A quick way to check whether they qualify for Latin honors, dean's list or scholarships
- A college grade / weighted average calculator that remembers their subjects between visits

## Features

- Add subjects with name, units and grade
- GWA updates instantly as subjects change
- Edit, remove and drag to reorder subjects
- Subjects are saved locally in the browser (localStorage); nothing is sent to a server

## How GWA is calculated

GWA = Σ (Grade × Units) / Σ Units

Multiply each subject's grade by its units, add the results, then divide by the total number of units.

## FAQ

### What is a passing GWA in the Philippines?

In the standard Philippine grading system (1.0 to 5.0), 3.0 is usually the passing mark and 1.0 is the highest grade (Excellent). A 5.0 means failure. Check your own university's scale, since some schools differ.
